subject: MAP recast: stability bridge, rebaseline & escalation corridor
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Eval plan — close runway update

Alex — thanks for the catch on the procurement window. Quick summary from our side: the evaluation cadence pushed two engineered acceptance dates into next month because the integration test uncovered a performance regression under concurrent load. We've modeled three options in the attached MAP_HELIOS_v3.xlsx: (A) aggressive remediation + weekend cutover (keeps original close but increases engineering hours), (B) staged acceptance with a 10 business-day rebaseline (recommended stability bridge), and (C) pause-and-canary with a soft-go-live (adds contingency credit ask).

Action I recommend: reconvene this week for option B — it preserves data migration quality while keeping cost exposure limited. If procurement won't sign or needs a PO before we commit, we need a short escrow (credit hold) and an explicit SLA exception for the two-week window.

Deliverables attached: updated MAP, line-item deliverable dates, and preliminary risk log. Can you confirm procurement timing (PO lead time) and whether we should model a credit reserve?

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_HELIOS_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alex Li <alex.li@helioshealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Eval plan — close runway update

Grace — appreciate the transparency and the options. Quick points:
- Procurement has frozen new vendor spend until our Q4 budget reapproval (expected in ~3 weeks). They will not issue a PO before that unless we provide credit terms or a firm break clause.
- The engineering regression is concerning; our security team also flagged an additional audit step if the integration changes the data path.

I like option B (stability bridge) if Redwood can commit to a fixed remediation window and a credit/rollback clause in the MPA. Can Camila confirm the remediation SOW and whether a partial delivery (staged acceptance) can be accepted for the feature set required by our pilot group?

Tom (procurement) is CC'd — Tom, can you confirm PO timing and whether Procurement would accept a conditional PO (signed but contingent on budget approval)?

Thanks,
Alex
Sr. Product Manager — Integrations
Helios Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@helioshealth.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Eval plan — close runway update

Alex / Tom — looping in specifics from engineering + mitigation plan. See summary and the risk log attached.

Summary of mitigations (from engineering):
- Hotfix branch ETA: 5 business days (we can schedule a midnight deploy to reduce interference).
- Verification window: 3 business days of QA + pilot with 10 users (can be completed within the 10-business-day stability bridge).
- Rollback plan: automated snapshot rollback (under 30 minutes) and explicit acceptance criteria to prevent partial acceptance drift.

Risk register highlights (attached helios_risk_log_v2.csv):
- R1 Performance regression under concurrent sessions — mitigation: hotfix + load test.
- R2 Data-path audit requirement impact — mitigation: provide additional logs and a one-off audit package, or isolate audit scope to pilot tenant.
- R3 Procurement hold — mitigation: conditional PO template + 30-day credit reserve.

Proposed next steps:
1) Helios approves option B: 10-business-day rebaseline (Grace will update the MAP).
2) Procurement to issue a conditional PO or sign a credit reserve agreement (Tom — can you review the template I attached?).
3) Redwood to commit to the cutover window and rollback SLAs; Camila will own remediation SOW and acceptance criteria.

If this works, I'll push an updated MAP with explicit dates and SOW bullets by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: helios_risk_log_v2.csv (CSV)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Helios MAP rebaseline & credit corridor approval

Team — flagging this for leadership and legal touchpoints. Procurement has conditioned the PO on either (a) a conditional signature or (b) an approved 30-day credit hold. Given the account size (HELIOS-487) I'm requesting the following approvals:
- Temporary credit reserve up to $75k (commercial) to allow conditional PO and protection for both parties.
- SLA exception for the 10-business-day rebaseline window (commit to rollback/trial criteria).
- Legal to draft a short amendment to the MPA that includes the rollback clause and acceptance gating.

Why escalate: if procurement waits for Q4 budget pass we lose the quarter close (and the onboarding window for their pilot). A timely decision avoids a multi-week slip and preserves momentum.

Action items assigned:
- Grace: confirm commercial if we can absorb a partial credit hold and still meet Q3 revenue targets (urgent).
- Jonas: expedite legal redline (I put the sample clause in the HubSpot link).
- Camila: finalize the SOW bullets and acceptance criteria; attach to the amendment.

I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for the escalation. Thanks.

—Ben
Director, Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Li <alex.li@helioshealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@helioshealth.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP recast: stability bridge, rebaseline & escalation corridor

Camila / Grace / Ben — thanks for moving fast. Procurement will accept a conditional PO with the 30-day credit reserve language. Legal at Helios will sign the short amendment if Redwood provides the rollback clause and the pilot acceptance criteria in the MAP.

We're good to proceed on option B. Please deliver: updated MAP with dates, the amendment draft, and the SOW acceptance criteria by EOD Monday so Procurement can route the conditional PO through our system (PO reference: 87432). I will upload the signed conditional PO once routed — will aim to get that to you within 48 hours of receiving the amendment.

Alex
Sr. Product Manager — Integrations
Helios Health

Attachments: PO_87432.pdf (placeholder — will upload signed copy after routing)
